_meta.purpose: Candidate addresses the votion cron ALWAYS balance-checks, in addition to tx_search discoveries. Public LCDs prune history, so depositors from before the retention window are undiscoverable automatically (the vault exposes no holder query; denom_owners is unimplemented on available LCDs — probed 2026-07-16). Add known/suspected vault depositors here (e.g. the aDAO multisig); the cron verifies by LIVE balance, so a wrong guess simply shows zero and drops out — nothing is ever assumed.
